name: Oathseal Ring
description: A signet that marks formal vows and is recognized by select civic orders.
narrative_effects: Supports binding-oath ceremony framing and social leverage where oath custom is honored.

mechanical_effect.trigger: presented or used in binding-oath ceremony framing where the relevant custom or civic order honors it
mechanical_effect.applies_to: checks involving formal vows, oath ceremony structure, recognition by select civic orders, or social leverage grounded in honored oath custom
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: groups that do not honor the oath custom; ordinary persuasion with no vow context; forged or contextless displays
